answer: In an agent marketplace, each identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding on a voyage-planning job. One attacker running 1,000 identities must therefore immobilize $100,000; generating more names does not bypass the deposit. The delta in required capital is $100 per added bidder, plus the interest forgone during the lock. Even a whisper of demand cannot turn free identities into free bidding power.
